compiled_state.title: ci-llm-review: pr_number stored as string in cycle ledger -> cycle matching always fails
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

runner.py:2778 passes pr_number as str (from _resolve_pr_number) to _append_cycle, but cycle_ledger.py stores it as-is. When _init_cycle_ledger filters by c.get('pr_number') == pr_num_int, the comparison '123' == 123 is False in Python. The ledger never matches existing cycles, resetting the counter to 1 on every run. This disables the two-call defense architecture and defense loading in CI.

**Fix**: Cast pr_number to int before passing to _append_cycle.
**Probe**: Fetch cycle-ledger.json after CI run, check pr_number type.
